name: wds_mscoco_captions2017
description: A WebDataset-formatted collection of the MS COCO 2017 image-caption pairs intended for training and evaluating image captioning and image-text matching models. It provides images paired with human-written captions suitable for standard captioning benchmarks and retrieval tasks.
reputation: Derived from the widely used MS COCO dataset; commonly used in image captioning and image-text retrieval research.
